svg.title: Hematuria and proteinuria decision chart: proteinuria is quantified, then sorted by pattern into transient, orthostatic or persistent glomerular proteinuria; hematuria is confirmed on microscopy, then sorted into glomerular or structural; each column gives the clues, numbered workup and next step, with rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis flagged as the emergency
